what_this_is: WP-D5 D5.1 labelled question set. 60 questions in six kinds. Three of the kinds carry a MECHANICAL gold set — a property of the corpus that no labelling can change — and are scored automatically. The other three need the operator's judgement and are emitted to the labelling sheet.

gold_kinds.geo: About one named place. Mechanical gold: `specific` = the findings where that place is the subject in its own right (it is the slice the finding is about, the value the pattern highlights, or the exception to it); `any` = every finding that names the place at all, including as one of twenty members following a pattern. Hit-rate is measured against `specific`, irrelevant-shown against `any`.
gold_kinds.measure: About a named quantity. Mechanical gold: the findings mined on the measure columns measure_keywords.json maps the phrase to.
gold_kinds.none: Something the current analysis genuinely has nothing on. Mechanical gold: the EMPTY set. Any answer at all is a false answer.
gold_kinds.vague: Legitimate, broad, and answerable by several findings at once. Needs operator labels — 'is spending on track' has no mechanical right answer.
gold_kinds.why: Not a retrieval question. Carried here so D5.2's reframe path is exercised on the same set, per the brief.
gold_kinds.open: Free-form officer phrasing that does not name a place or a measure cleanly. Needs operator labels.
